new-horizons.mastery.artilleryVolley.des: Your ballista gains {magnitude} additional attack(s) during an eligible shooting action. Normal targeting and action restrictions still apply.
Your ballista's ranged attacks ignore distance and wall damage penalties. Other damage modifiers and targeting restrictions still apply.
new-horizons.mastery.artilleryRepair.des: At its normal pre-turn regeneration step, your surviving ballista restores up to {magnitude} health, capped at maximum health. This cannot revive a destroyed machine.
